id: title:Gilbert09:accept raw int field data types when building schemas

review.posthog_relevance: Supports warehouse ingestion compatibility by allowing Google Ads field data types to be passed as raw integers alongside enums, potentially aiding serialization or compatibility with downstream systems expecting integer values.
review.reason: The change is a narrow, localized maintenance update. P1.F1.H1 and P1.F2.H1 demonstrate the implementation of passing Google Ads field data types as integers alongside enums, which could support compatibility with systems expecting raw integers. review.uncertainty: The production benefit depends on whether callers actually pass integers, which is not shown. No test or implementation change is shown to demonstrate this is used or safe.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds support for passing GoogleAdsFieldDataType as an int instead of an enum, and removes a redundant type ignore.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse ingestion code to pass the underlying integer value of an enum rather than the enum object, potentially supporting serialization or compatibility with systems expecting raw integers. No test or implementation change is shown to demonstrate this is used or safe.

observations.behavior: Adds a test parameter and a conditional to pass either the enum or its integer value, and uses the integer in the column construction.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a test case exercising the new integer-path. This could help verify compatibility, but the production benefit depends on whether callers actually pass integers, which is not shown.

observations.behavior: Removes a redundant type ignore comment, retaining the same STRING value.
observations.posthog_connection: Removes a suppression of a type-check warning. This could indicate the original ignore was unnecessary; no runtime behavior change is shown.
